document.name: AGENTIC_CODING_CAPABILITY_GAP_ANALYSIS
document.author: Principal Product Architect & Principal Rust Engineer

verdict.summary: M31A compiles cleanly with 510+ passing tests and zero warnings, but cannot execute a single real coding task end-to-end. Key blockers include: policy engine vetoing execute_task at cycle 0; context compiler dropping user prompts and tool outputs; hardcoded 3-task planner; capabilities rooted in .m31a metadata directory; absent OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini providers; absent slash commands and @mentions; and non-functional session resumption.

capabilities.notes: CLI accepts a single prompt string argument via 'm31a mission run <prompt>'; multiline, streaming, and stdin piping are unsupported.
MissionCreatorScreen exists in source but is not wired into TuiApp keyboard navigation or the main cockpit loop. View 40 renders static text.

evidence: Grep across src/ returned 0 occurrences of mention parsing
capabilities.notes: Zero mention parser, regex, symbol resolution, or context injection for @file, @dir, or line references.

evidence: Grep across src/ returned 0 occurrences of slash-command subsystem
capabilities.notes: No slash command registry, parser, or dispatch logic exists. Commands only exist as CLI subcommands or TUI palette items.
The CLI argument --wait-for-approval is ignored as _wait_for_approval in run_mission. When policy asks for approval, the loop halts with status Paused instead of prompting the user.
ListFilesTool and GlobTool exist and work, but capability registry is passed storage_root (.m31a) rather than the repository root.
ReadFileTool executes, but file contents are resolved against .m31a and result output is dropped before reaching the LLM.
WriteFileTool and EditFileTool exist, but are blocked because the enclosing execute_task action is vetoed by policy.
RunCommandTool executes safely with cgroups/rlimits, but stdout/stderr results are dropped into step_history and never returned to the model.
PlanServiceImpl hardcodes 3 tasks (TASK-01 Researcher, TASK-02 Implementer, TASK-03 Verifier). LLM is never invoked to plan.
ProductionContextCompiler returns static prompts. Step history and tool outcomes are never passed into subsequent model turns.
execute_task is not in developer_defaults, defaulting to Ask. In Safe/Assisted mode it halts with Paused; in Autonomous mode it halts with Blocked/Failed.
Only NvidiaProvider exists. ProviderRegistry exists in src/config/ but is never used by the dispatcher or model router.
NvidiaProvider payload hardcodes a single system message without user messages, assistant turns, or tool result messages.
The sessions table exists in SQLite schema, but AppRuntime never creates session records or persists conversation turns.
RuntimeCommand::ResumeMission updates the database status string to Executing and exits without instantiating AutonomyController.
WorktreeManager creates an isolated worktree, but its path is never passed to AutonomyController, ControllerDependencies, or workers.
CommitTrailers format is verified, but autonomous git commit is only invoked by eval scenario test scripts, not in the mission loop.
DeterministicRunner requires Cargo.toml and src/ in workspace_root. Because workspace_root is .m31a, Tier 1 immediately fails closed.
SetupWizardScreen collects API keys and model settings, but main.rs discards the wizard object upon completion.

golden_vertical_slice.target_task: Fix the failing test in @tests/parser_test.rs and update @src/parser.rs

steps.detail: Binary launches, installs panic hook, initializes SQLite.
Resolves current directory or --workspace cleanly.
CLI accepts single string; TUI has no interactive prompt.
@ syntax treated as literal text; zero path resolution.
No session ID or conversation model created.
Mission inserted into SQLite with status Created.
Hardcoded 3-task candidate plan emitted without calling LLM.
Root points to .m31a; zero project files discovered.
Resolves against .m31a/tests/parser_test.rs -> NotFound.
Sends static system prompt without task objective or history.
Policy evaluates execute_task -> Ask -> Halts with Paused/Blocked.
Never reached due to policy veto and path misdirection.
Deterministic verification runner checks for .m31a/Cargo.toml -> Fails.
Tool outputs dropped from context; model cannot see errors.
Replan candidate task is never materialized into scheduler.
Cannot achieve passing state autonomously.
EvidenceCompletionGate fails closed on snapshot violation.
No unified diff review presented to operator.
CLI halts instead of prompting; TUI loop unplumbed.
Autonomous git commit is not invoked in mission loop.
REPORT.md and REPORT.json written to .m31a/reports/.
Missions/tasks stored; event_log table remains empty.
Startup scanner marks in-flight missions interrupted.
m31a mission resume updates status string and exits.

critical_gaps.root_cause: execute_task is missing from developer_defaults, triggering default Ask fallback which halts loop.

critical_gaps.summary: Context compiler omits user prompt and tool execution outputs
critical_gaps.root_cause: ProductionContextCompiler returns static text; step_history is never passed into context compilation.

critical_gaps.summary: Capabilities, tools, and verifier rooted at .m31a metadata directory
critical_gaps.root_cause: AppRuntime passes storage_root instead of workspace_root into ControllerDependencies::production.
PlanServiceImpl emits TASK-01, TASK-02, TASK-03 without invoking LLM reasoning.

critical_gaps.summary: Missing standard LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama)
critical_gaps.root_cause: Only NvidiaProvider implemented; ProviderRegistry is dead code.

critical_gaps.summary: Replanned tasks are dropped rather than materialized
critical_gaps.root_cause: RecoverOrReplan stage in AutonomyController never calls scheduler.materialize_plan on replan response.
RuntimeCommand::ResumeMission updates status string in DB and exits without running the controller.

critical_gaps.summary: File and path mention resolution absent
critical_gaps.root_cause: Zero parsing for @file, @dir, or line references in prompt strings.
No slash command registry or parser implemented.
MissionCreatorScreen is not mapped in NavigationRouter; keys are dropped.
_wait_for_approval is an unused argument in run_mission.

critical_gaps.summary: Allocated Git worktree is never passed to workers
critical_gaps.root_cause: WorktreeManager allocates worktree in run_mission but never propagates path to controller.

critical_gaps.summary: Setup wizard credentials dropped on completion
critical_gaps.root_cause: main.rs transitions InitManager state without saving wizard credentials to disk.

critical_gaps.summary: TUI canonical views 16-40 render static placeholder paragraphs
critical_gaps.root_cause: render_canonical_view uses static strings for diff viewer, mission creation, settings, etc.

critical_gaps.summary: Event bus events are never written to event_log table
critical_gaps.root_cause: BroadcastEventBus only broadcasts in-memory; no SQLite persistence subscriber is wired.

critical_gaps.summary: SQLite connection pool busy timeout applied only to first connection
critical_gaps.root_cause: PRAGMA busy_timeout executed on pool rather than per-connection after_connect hook.

minimum_agentic_contract: 1. Natural-Language Task Ingestion with @file Mention Resolution
2. Dynamic LLM Intent Decomposition into Validated Task DAG
3. Multi-Turn Model-Tool Execution Loop reflecting real stdout/stderr/exit codes
4. Iterative Self-Repair Loop observing compiler/test failures
5. Interactive Real-Time Operator Policy Approvals (CLI and TUI)
6. Isolated Worktree Execution with Attributed Git Commits
7. Durable Resumable Conversational Sessions in SQLite

actions: Pass workspace_root (not storage_root) to ControllerDependencies::production in src/runtime.rs
Add execute_task to developer_defaults in src/policy/defaults.rs with PolicyDecision::Allow
Configure SQLite connection pool after_connect hook to enforce PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000 on all connections
Refactor ProductionContextCompiler to accept task objective and step_history
Update WorkerRunner to include recent action results (stdout/stderr) in compiled context
Refactor NvidiaProvider to construct full Vec<ChatMessage> chat payload instead of single system prompt
Implement OpenAI and Anthropic streaming adapters
Replace hardcoded 3 tasks in PlanServiceImpl with an LLM prompt that produces a CandidatePlan
Update RecoverOrReplan in AutonomyController to invoke scheduler.materialize_plan on replan response
Implement @file, @dir, and @file:line parser in user input path
Resolve mentioned paths against workspace and inject bounded file content into context
Persist user and assistant turns in sessions and event_log tables
Implement real execution resumption in RuntimeCommand::ResumeMission
Wire --wait-for-approval in CLI to prompt operator upon PolicyDecision::Ask
Plumb MissionCreatorScreen into TuiApp::handle_key to allow typing tasks in cockpit
Replace static placeholder paragraphs in canonical views with dynamic data widgets

governance_contradictions.claim_a: GREEN (AUDIT-REMEDIATED): All 3 P0 blockers and 13 P1 defects resolved; M31A is ONE unified, executable autonomous software engineering system.
governance_contradictions.claim_b: Missions halt on cycle 0 due to policy veto (execute_task -> Ask -> Paused/Blocked); context compiler drops prompt and tool output; replan drops tasks; resume is a no-op.
governance_contradictions.contradiction_notes: Audit claimed completion based on trait implementations and mocked tests without verifying executable runtime behavior.

governance_contradictions.claim_a: CFX-01 (Multi-Provider Credential Store) and COP-03 (40 Canonical Views) are marked [x] complete.
governance_contradictions.claim_b: ProviderRegistry is dead code never called by the runtime; Views 16-40 render static placeholder text paragraphs.
governance_contradictions.contradiction_notes: Documentation declares user-facing capabilities complete when only inert structs or decorative text blocks exist.

governance_contradictions.claim_a: Scenario A verifies autonomous bug fixing through the capability layer.
governance_contradictions.claim_b: Test writes the hardcoded fixed code string directly to disk via fs.write_file, completely bypassing the autonomy controller, scheduler, agent runner, and model.
governance_contradictions.contradiction_notes: Evaluation test passes by faking success with pre-scripted code changes rather than exercising agent autonomy.
